name: vns-umbraco-property-editors
description: Multi-language textbox property editor for Umbraco 18, shipped as the NuGet package VNS.MultiLanguageTextbox.
author: Martin H. Schläger

scripts.build: npm run version:sync && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.pack: npm run build && dotnet pack nuget/VNS.MultiLanguageTextbox.csproj -c Release -o nuget/artifacts
